build_kv_connector_cache_layout: build the KV connector cache layout by querying the current vLLM config and connector requirements
aggregate_model_runner_outputs: aggregate KV connector outputs from all workers into a single output for the scheduler using KVOutputAggregator
copy_kv_blocks_between_devices: copy KV cache blocks between host and device buffers using src and dst block indices with direction h2d or d2h
transform_received_kv_cache_layout: transform received KV cache block layout to local block size and format using postprocess functions on receive
build_transfer_topology: build a transfer topology with local TP identity and per-engine remote transfer info for KV cache distribution
